The SEM micrographs of different samples all show a dual phase γ/ γ ʹ microstructure with a uniform distribution of γ ʹ phases in the γ matrix. However, the γ′ phase of samples in different orientations exhibits different morphologies. Usually, the γ′ phase in single crystal superalloys after heat treatment is cubic and six cubic planes are parallel to (001), (010), and (100) crystal planes [ 38 , 39 ]. Due to proximity to [001] orientation, the γ′ phase of samples A and B is approximately cubic in shape as shown in Fig. 1 (a, b).
